Subject: Update on Department Budget Request

Dear [Name],

I am writing to provide an update regarding your recent request for a budget increase for your department. After careful review, we have decided not to approve the increase at this time, as the current justification does not align with the company's broader financial strategy.

However, we are open to reconsidering this request if you are able to provide a more detailed explanation. Specifically, please include concrete examples and data outlining the anticipated benefits of the additional funds. This will help us better understand the impact and value of the proposed investment.

Please let me know if you have any questions or if you would like to discuss this further.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
